examples.en: She was brave enough to stand up to the bully.
examples.zh: 她足够勇敢，敢于对抗那个恶霸。

examples.en: It was a brave decision to quit his job and start his own business.
examples.zh: 辞去工作自己创业是一个勇敢的决定。

examples.en: The brave firefighters rescued the family from the burning building.
examples.zh: 勇敢的消防员从燃烧的大楼中救出了那家人。
